sentenceSets.sentence: The authorized biography was so hagiographic that critics dismissed it as a press release rather than a serious work.

answerChoices.reasoning: Flattery is praise aimed at pleasing its object, but the comparison to a press release points to a book that treats its subject as beyond criticism throughout rather than one that merely pays compliments.
A sympathetic biography can still record failings, whereas critics here refused to count the book as serious work at all.
Being derivative means borrowing from earlier books, while the objection raised is about the reverential treatment of the subject.
This is close, since a press release promotes, but promotion describes the book's function in the marketplace rather than the worshipful posture toward the subject that provoked the charge.
An exhaustive biography would be faulted for length, not dismissed as publicity.
Whether the subject was living tells us nothing about why critics refused to take the book seriously.
The sentence already calls the biography authorized, so this contradicts its own setup.
Relying on anecdotes is a methodological weakness, but the complaint is about a book that reads like advertising for its subject.
A scathing book attacks its subject, which no one would mistake for a press release.
Impartiality is what critics found missing, not what they objected to.
Critics denied the book was serious work, so it cannot be faulted for being scholarly.

sentenceSets.sentence: Museum labels written in the 1950s are relentlessly hagiographic about the collector, mentioning neither where the objects came from nor what he paid.

answerChoices.reasoning: Vagueness would mean the labels say little of substance, but they are wordy enough about the collector and silent only on the awkward questions.
Being outdated would concern the scholarship's age, while the problem described is the adoring treatment of one man alongside two pointed omissions.
Brevity would explain the omissions innocently, yet the word 'relentlessly' indicates the labels dwell at length on their subject.
Technical labels would discuss materials and dating, whereas these are preoccupied with the collector himself.
Anonymity would mean no author is named, which says nothing about how the collector is portrayed.
How the labels were produced has no bearing on their treatment of provenance and price.
The number of languages used does not explain a reverent posture toward the collector.
Illegible labels could not be characterized by what they say about the collector.
Critical labels would raise exactly the questions of provenance and price the sentence says are missing.
Accusation runs against a treatment that avoids every uncomfortable fact about the man.
An apologetic tone would concede fault, which labels silent on where the objects came from plainly do not.

sentenceSets.sentence: The documentary is hagiographic for its first hour, then abruptly turns on its subject in the final twenty minutes.

answerChoices.reasoning: Tedium describes how dull the film is, but the contrast drawn is with turning on the subject, which sets up an earlier stretch of unbroken admiration.
Meandering would mean the film lacks direction, while the sharp reversal at the end implies the first hour had a very clear posture toward its subject.
Restraint would mean holding back, whereas the pivot at the end gains its force from an opening hour of unrestrained reverence.
Conventionality concerns the film's form, but the contrast is about its attitude toward the person on screen.
A documentary with sound cannot be silent, and the reversal concerns what it says about its subject.
Animation is a production technique and would not switch partway through in a way that contrasts with turning on the subject.
An unfinished film could not have a deliberate structural turn in its final twenty minutes.
Subtitles are a presentation choice with no relation to the film's stance toward its subject.
Hostility is what arrives at the end, so it cannot also describe the hour that precedes the turn.
A damning opening would make the late reversal pointless.
Skepticism early on would blunt the abruptness the sentence emphasizes.
